reason: The pivot plate looks like the mounting point for the flippers, so I'll attach it to the table first.
expectation: The plate will mount on the table and provide a pivot for the flipper blades.

effect: The pivot plate combines with the blades first, making button-operated flippers rather than mounting directly on the table.
reaction: The short button and returning paddle make the mechanism clearer; I was surprised the blades had to go on first.
reason: The assembled flippers should now fit onto the marble table.
expectation: The flippers will attach to the table for the player to operate.

effect: The assembled flippers are now fitted to the marble table.
reason: The target arches look like the next playing features to add to the table.
expectation: The arches will be fitted as targets for the marble.

effect: The target arches are now installed on the pinball table.
reason: The score wheel should add a way to track hits on the targets.
expectation: The score wheel will attach to the table.

effect: The score wheel has no available combination yet, so another step must come first.
reaction: I was surprised it could not be attached yet.
reason: Trying the marble on the assembled table may reveal what still needs adjustment.
expectation: The marble will test the flippers and targets, possibly revealing what the table needs next.

alternatives.reason: The screwdriver might be needed to adjust or secure a component.

effect: The marble test revealed that the launcher has an adjustable stop for reaching the top arch.
reaction: The distinction between the gentle launch and the longer shot makes the adjustment purposeful.
reason: The screwdriver may adjust the launcher's stop for the top arch.

choice.with: Pinball table on its gentle setting

expectation: The screwdriver will adjust the launcher for a longer shot.

effect: The screwdriver moved the launcher stop, allowing a longer but still gentle launch.
reaction: The explanation of the captive stop makes the adjustment feel purposeful.
reason: The adjusted launcher is ready to test with the marble, especially against the top arch.

choice.with: Pinball table with a longer launch

expectation: The marble will test whether the longer launch reaches the top arch.

effect: The longer launch reached the top arch, and the run demonstrated all three targets.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the adjustment make the top arch reachable without making the marble stronger.
reason: Now that all three targets have been tested, the score wheel may be ready to add.

choice.with: Pinball table after a three-arch run

expectation: The score wheel will attach so players can keep track of their shots.

effect: The score wheel attached after the three-arch run, and the completed table is ready for the fair.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the tested game become a finished stall, though I had expected to attach the wheel earlier.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adjusting the launcher and testing the longer shot was most worthwhile: it showed how the stop changes the launch and made the top target reachable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the score wheel before it was available was the least worthwhile moment; the feedback did not explain what had to happen first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the flipper blades had to be assembled with the pivot plate before mounting them on the table.

arbitrary.text: The score wheel's initial unavailability felt somewhat arbitrary because I could not see why it needed to wait until after the test run.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the launcher adjustment connected a practical mechanism to a noticeable result, and I am curious what the fair will do next.
